description_en: Modifies the name, description, and peak bandwidth of a specified elastic IP address (EIP)
description_zh: 调用ModifyEipAddressAttribute接口修改指定EIP的名称、描述信息和带宽峰值
kebab_example: aliyun vpc modify-eip-address-attribute --allocation-id eip-2zeerraiwb7uj6i0d0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyEipAddressAttribute

parameters.help_en: The ID of the pay-as-you-go EIP that you want to modify
parameters.help_zh: 需要修改的后付费类型EIP的ID
parameters.name: allocation_id

parameters.help_en:
The peak bandwidth of the EIP. Valid values:

1 to 200: If the EIP is billed on a pay-by-data-transfer basis. Unit: Mbit/s. 

1 to 500: If the EIP is billed on a pay-by-bandwidth basis. Unit: Mbit/s
parameters.help_zh:
需要修改EIP的带宽峰值，取值：

1~200，按使用流量计费，单位为Mbps。 

1~500，按固定带宽计费，单位为Mbps
parameters.name: bandwidth

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the EIP.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
EIP所属的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the EIP that you want to modify.  

The name must be 0 to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
需要修改的EIP的名称。  

名称长度为0-128个字符，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The description of the EIP that you want to modify.  

The description must be 0 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
需要修改的EIP描述信息。  

长度为0-256个字符，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头
parameters.name: description
